en: Daniel 9

p.src: 1  In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

ja: カルデア人の王国の王とされた、メディア
の一族に属するアハシュエロスの
en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—
u.src: 1  In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the offspring of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—

p.src: 2  in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

ja: ダニエルは書物によって年数を悟った。それは、エルサレムの荒廃の期間が七十年であると、
en: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.
u.src: 2  in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the LORD’s word came to Jeremiah the prophet for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

ja: 9:2 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
en: 9:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 3  I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

ja: は主なる神に顔を向け、
en: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.
u.src: 3  I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

p.src: 4  I prayed to the LORD my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

en: I prayed to the LORD my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,
u.src: 4  I prayed to the LORD my God, and made confession, and said, “Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

p.src: 5  we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

ja: をなし、背いた。あなたの命令と定めから
en: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.
u.src: 5  we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances.

p.src: 6  We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

ja: あなたのしもべである
わなかった。彼らはあなたの御名によって、私たちの王たち、君主たち、父祖たち、この地のすべての民に語った。
en: We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
u.src: 6  We haven’t listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

p.src: 7  “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

ja: はあなたにある。しかし
い散らされたあらゆる
々で恥を負っている。私たちがあなたに
en: “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.
u.src: 7  “Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as it is today; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

p.src: 8  Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

ja: たちには顔を覆う恥がある。
en: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
u.src: 8  Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

p.src: 9  To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.
u.src: 9  To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him.

p.src: 10  We haven’t obeyed the LORD our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

ja: わず、主がしもべである
en: We haven’t obeyed the LORD our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
u.src: 10  We haven’t obeyed the LORD our God’s voice, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

p.src: 11  Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, and not obeying your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.

ja: まことに、全イスラエルはあなたの
わなかった。 それゆえ、
en: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, and not obeying your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.
u.src: 11  Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, and not obeying your voice. “Therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us, for we have sinned against him.

p.src: 12  He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

ja: いをもたらされた。エルサレムに
われたようなことは、天下のどこにも
en: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.
u.src: 12  He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

p.src: 13  As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of the LORD our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.

ja: されているとおり、このすべての
るために、私たちの神、主の恵みを求めなかった。
en: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of the LORD our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.
u.src: 13  As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us. Yet we have not entreated the favor of the LORD our God, that we should turn from our iniquities and have discernment in your truth.

p.src: 14  Therefore the LORD has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

ja: 、主は、なされるすべてのみわざにおいて義である。だが
en: Therefore the LORD has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.
u.src: 14  Therefore the LORD has watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for the LORD our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

p.src: 15  “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.

en: “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.
u.src: 15  “Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as it is today, we have sinned. We have done wickedly.

p.src: 16  Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

ja: りを、あなたの町エルサレム、あなたの
からそらしてください。
のために、エルサレムとあなたの
からそしられています。
en: Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.
u.src: 16  Lord, according to all your righteousness, please let your anger and your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

p.src: 17  “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

en: “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.
u.src: 17  “Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

p.src: 18  My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

ja: たちは自分たちの義によって
いをささげるのではなく、ただあなたの
いなるあわれみによって願うのです。
en: My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.
u.src: 18  My God, turn your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name; for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

p.src: 19  Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

ja: らせないでください。あなたの町とあなたの
en: Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”
u.src: 19  Lord, hear. Lord, forgive. Lord, listen and do. Don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.”

p.src: 20  While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God—

en: While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God—
u.src: 20  While I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the LORD my God for the holy mountain of my God—

p.src: 21  yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

ja: のささげ物の時刻ごろ、
en: yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.
u.src: 21  yes, while I was speaking in prayer—the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

p.src: 22  He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.

en: He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.
u.src: 22  He instructed me and talked with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come to give you wisdom and understanding.

p.src: 23  At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.

ja: が出された。あなたは深く愛されているので、
た。だから、この事をよく
en: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.
u.src: 23  At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved. Therefore consider the matter and understand the vision.

p.src: 24  “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

en: “Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, to make an end of sins, to make reconciliation for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.
